# CRFsuite fixtures

File details for `crfsuite/`. See also: [AI model fixtures](../README.md)
(summary, licences), [CRFsuite support](../../../../working-docs/implementation/crfsuite-support.md)
(format layout).

Both files are generated by `crfsuite/generate_fixtures.py` with
python-crfsuite 0.9.12 (L-BFGS, 20 iterations), in a throwaway venv; the
library is not a Pitloom dependency. The committed binaries are the
reference: tests never regenerate them, and byte-identity across platforms is
not verified (identical across runs on one macOS arm64 machine).

Common to both: magic `lCRF`, type `FOMC`, version 100, header
`num_features` 0 (the writer never sets it; the count is `FEAT.num`),
CQDB `flag` 0.
